title: Annie and the Lanterns
moral: Working together helps others stay safe.

scenes.summary: Annie is asked by the Sheriff to place lanterns to help travelers.
scenes.text: Annie, a brave cowgirl, is asked by the Sheriff to put lanterns along the path to help travelers at night.
scenes.image_prompt: cowgirl with horse talking to sheriff in sunny wild west, colorful cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: Once upon a time in the sunny Wild West there was a brave cowgirl named Annie. Annie wore a big brown hat and shiny boots. She loved riding her horse Daisy across the wide open plains. One day the Sheriff came and asked Annie to place lanterns along the path so travelers could see at night. Annie agreed happily. She packed lanterns and set off with Daisy. Along the way she met a friendly rabbit named Benny who joined her. Together they placed lanterns. They reached a river and built a small bridge with logs to cross safely. At sunset they placed the final lantern and lit them all. The path glowed brightly and safely. Annie felt proud. She and her friends returned home knowing they had helped many travelers.

scenes.summary: Annie must find a way to cross a river to continue her task.
scenes.text: Annie reaches a wide river and wonders how to cross it safely.
